name: Python basics
description: First steps: input, values, strings, collections, decisions, loops and a first function.

name: Strings and collections
description: Practice indexing, methods, lists, tuples, dictionaries and sets after the basics.

name: Decisions, loops and comprehensions
description: Build from branching and iteration to counting, comprehensions and sentinel input.

name: Functions and standard modules
description: Return values, default arguments, imports and small standard-library tools.

name: Files and small reports
description: Read, write, append, organise and filter tiny local files; introduce exceptions.

name: Spreadsheets and documents
description: Read and create small Excel, Word and PDF files using supplied libraries.

name: Python and SQLite
description: Connect, query, insert and join using tiny local SQLite databases.

name: Web data and HTML
description: Build URLs and parse saved JSON, XML and HTML responses without depending on external services.

name: Scientific data and plots
description: Use NumPy, pandas, Biopython and matplotlib with small local datasets.

name: Image processing
description: Inspect and transform tiny images, then introduce grayscale conversion and edge detection.
